story.jaymoskingdoms.midnight_bargain.op: The right hour, and the right stone. You have the look of someone who wants.
story.jaymoskingdoms.midnight_bargain.wh: Whatever answers, at this hour. Tonight that is me. Does a name matter, if the word is kept?
story.jaymoskingdoms.midnight_bargain.wa: You came with a seal already warm in your hand. You want. I only listen.
story.jaymoskingdoms.midnight_bargain.te: The seal knows you. All it lacks is your word, and mine.
story.jaymoskingdoms.midnight_bargain.co: A little. Later. When I ask.
It is the only answer anyone gets.
story.jaymoskingdoms.midnight_bargain.qu: Will you pay what is asked, when it is asked?
story.jaymoskingdoms.midnight_bargain.le: Then go back to your bed. The night comes round again.
story.jaymoskingdoms.midnight_bargain.kn: Kneel, then, and say it back to me. The words will come.
story.jaymoskingdoms.midnight_bargain.la: Too slow. Words have to be meant. Another night.
story.jaymoskingdoms.midnight_bargain.se: Done. Hold the seal and name what you want. I will be listening.
story.jaymoskingdoms.midnight_bargain.wo: In the dark I was answered.
What I am given, I will give back.
When it is asked, it is paid.
story.jaymoskingdoms.midnight_bargain.gi: With the seal in hand, say a spell's name aloud to cast it (/kingdommic on)
